summary: Build model inventories, validation plans, and governance scorecards. Train your team to reduce model risk and improve control.
lede: Analytics governance and model validation help professionals set clear ownership and test whether models remain reliable. This course is for people who oversee analytics controls, validate models, assess data quality or report model risk. It develops practical skills in building model inventories, planning validation tests, monitoring performance drift, and documenting issues through governance scorecards and exception tracking.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who oversee analytics controls, validate models, review data quality, or report model risk and governance issues to management. It is built for people who need practical methods for governing analytics assets without losing speed, traceability, or credibility.
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, you should have working familiarity with analytics, reporting, or model-based decision processes, plus a basic understanding of data quality and control concepts. You do not need programming expertise to follow the course, although experience with spreadsheets, dashboards, or model documentation will help you move faster. The course uses practical governance templates and validation artefacts, and any advanced model engineering topics are treated at an operational level rather than a technical build level.
